content.title: Senior Backend Engineer
bullets: Designed and operated Python/Django microservices handling 40k requests/second on AWS ECS.
Owned the team's PostgreSQL data layer, including query optimization and replication topology.
Led migration from a monolith to event-driven services using SQS and Lambda.

job.title: Senior Backend Engineer
job.descriptionMd: We are hiring a Senior Backend Engineer (7+ years) to build and operate high-throughput Python services on AWS. You will own our PostgreSQL data layer and lead event-driven migrations using SQS/Lambda. Required: Python, Django or similar, PostgreSQL, AWS, distributed systems experience.
